noInvalidateCacheInOnSuccess.text: This invalidates the cache from inside an `onSuccess` handler. Use the `invalidateOnSuccess` option instead, which puts the invalidation list next to the request that makes it necessary and runs it automatically. Hand-written invalidation in a handler drifts from the request over time: somebody adds a field the request now affects and the handler does not know about it, so the stale read appears somewhere unrelated and nobody connects it back to this line.
